Every original GD field retained, including ell-1 not dividing 2e; no added prime or weight restriction and no assertion of full-GD data at ell=3.
Exact complete implication and same-valued unramified coefficient return, not an embedding of the whole original ramified coefficient ring.
Actual five-entry MeasG and eight-entry MeasW, six/eleven clauses, exact rational subgroup and source choice-based covolume.
Full MExistsCore/MExists with same bridge and literal antecedent blocks, including supplied Wb.
Original standard-frame guard in MWCore and InfTransfer; no unguarded arbitrary-frame strengthening.
All prescribed infinity/global-N/global-H/local-S measures retained exactly; source does not add local/restricted-product ties.

Literal ModelsOf and ModelBase on a supplied family, keeping the fixed space, scalar and exact arithmetic lattice.
Original cusp coefficient lattices, zMatE/zGam, rank and phase conventions, preserving exact half-trace normalization and all-rank scope.
Full true-volume GIs2 stage chosen once before every later W,V,S,N on the original column input.

checks.finding: Only TASK_ONE_CHAR_PROOF leaves the selected whole-obligation register. Its complete original contract text is byte-for-byte preserved, and the exact implication InpZ -> AutomorphyUnramifiedCoefficients -> OneChar is independently reviewed. The old class-C reconstruction task is now a class-B proved certificate. AUT_UNRAM_COEF remains open; no geometric or global-gain whole obligation closes.

One marked g1 must jointly provide FinA, AutB and LemW for the same original Dat and fixed iota. FinA quantifies over every actual local/global ring; AutB retains every push and Type-I point; LemW retains the middle-entry guard and every actual IsExt. OCH's local component, global model, rigidity and trace estimate do not manufacture that separate producer or invoke OneChar circularly to obtain it.

OCH30 retains every original closure, Coef, N!=0, e, GD, fixed iota, sigma and supplied base trace. No additional lower bound on ell or e is inserted. Applicable local finite-Artin constructions include nonreduced targets and critical e=1; full GD itself excludes ell=3 by its unchanged ell-1 not dividing 2e condition. Preserving prime-three scope does not assert a nonexistent full-GD case.

The OCH scope is the actual saturated ordinary component It, its twelve-variable chart with multiplicities (1,2,3,4,2), and the original normalized integral graded model. FinA is used for its quotient weight-zero module, not to claim finiteness of the ambient graded algebra. Formal Taylor division supplies the needed extension and lifting for arbitrary actual maps and derivations; no extra continuity premise is inserted.

The finite set consists of actual Adm3(iota,e,N) or Adm2(iota,e,N*abs(disc K)) homomorphisms, pairwise irredundant under RepIso. The Adm2 branch can be reducible in dimension three. The upper bound is reapplied to the final covering set rather than obtained by deleting positive summands. Vlen is bounded before finiteness is used; Vn divides by eO, v_ell(ell)=1, and the factor two remains exact.

OCH29 places the same finite character values in an unramified coefficient datum inside the fixed algebraic closure. It does not embed the entire possibly ramified original coefficient ring in an unramified ring. The exact GD predicate and trace scalar persist, and RV7 returns the identical representation set and normalized bound to the original supplied datum.

AMD proves the exact bridge, MGExists, standard-frame MWCore, InfTransfer and full MExistsCore/MExists. The weak original Haar-on-set predicate is promoted by its explicit Tonelli argument; no hidden Radon assumption is substituted. One bridge precedes every word and all five MeasTie equalities are literal. The original antecedent blocks, including Wb, remain supplied in MExists; its proof does not assert Bessel existence.

The prescribed MeasW constructor retains both infinity measures, both global N/H measures and every local S measure, absorbing required Haar scalars in finite factors. Rational-unipotent compact representatives and a Borel fundamental domain justify the source's choice-based covolume, including its almost-everywhere version. Covolume one then preserves infinity/H/local-S data. This supplies the measured portion, not the remaining normalized orbital/fiber or Siegel-Weil identities.

PUN keeps the actual CM host, fixed Hermitian matrix/scalar, every finite place including dyadic places, and nonprincipal projective lattices. Its local-to-global argument, exact principal congruence, finite index, flag freeness and uniform transvection modulus give every LatModel field. ModelsOf/ModelBase/NegXi still take the original FamilyUnif as a supplied input. All-family/all-rank LatZ and A=1 ExpoMatch use the original coefficient ideals, different and half-trace factor without saturation or a replacement lattice.

PUN20-PUN24 construct actual individual primitive marked period points, the source negative Weil sign, every positive torsion level, both markings, every C-to-k scalar extension, exact point equality and marked-genus nonemptiness. KTriv holds on all C-algebras, including nonreduced ones, by the separately named universal Picard foundation on every test scheme. The original Moduli representing object is supplied; named Riemann, Appell-Humbert, GAGA and Picard theorems are not counted as newly proved foundations.

Individual period points and their arithmetic models do not establish N1c or FrameUnif.exists_unf_hasPrinc. Reverse extraction at every moduli point, prescribed local period lifts, holomorphic families, simultaneous normalized theta frames and the exact FramesOK/CoverTri/FibTri/IsUnf/FromTest dictionary remain. Integral cusp spanning, higher CoversAt, all-tuple phase-correct class sums, one PointIdentCore with common lambda,z and base ClassSumsSpan remain coupled to the original common field, metric, measure, phase, both levels, Fits and eta agreements.

GCF supplies the finer KDq determinant law, all-rank relative determinant on given frames, prescribed-column extension keeping the actual local family, and OmegaCompatible in the existing coefficient field with the given period root. All five GroupCompatibilityAll fields and the joint IsRecG are constructed together. One GJStage is fixed before every later W,V,S,N; its VolTieG uses GV19 at its explicit retained true-volume foundation.

GCF15-GCF16 preserve the literal comparison map under arbitrary original submodules and real heights, including off-lattice tuples, and transport full IsRecG/ColT/ColumnDataSplitPrimes. GCF17 still requires the given WPt's single dependent (Gt,cmp,tw,ker) equality and joint (D,O) realization to identify the actual Extra.cmp/kernel. A canonical stage or unrelated isomorphic record does not supply the remaining rows, kernel/theta, divisor, object and gauge fields of Wit.

On the selected D3 class, its original ChosenE supplies ChosenTT and ChosenBad, hence TopsF and Adm2F on the same subset with the unchanged threshold. Outside D3, arbitrary-family admission remains an antecedent. The class-level LinkG consumer retains original TSel/common realization and both Closed quantifier orders, with all cutoffs and coefficient bounds chosen before later family data. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN remains open.

All 121 selected nodes and 161 requires edges are preserved. The 25 remaining whole obligations retain category, kind, status and gate; only six additive current qualifications change their contract text, preserving every previous word. Counts are 18 C plus 7 B, with 18 shared RH/Dirichlet-GRH, seven additional Dirichlet-GRH and zero RH-only. The seven Case-III/tensor/seed/rank-four tasks are unchanged and are not closed by the rank-three OneChar implication.

Completed six-field same-J Hida, LevelAlt/HasAut, both selected support Links, CNR3, finite PGK implication, Kato/InpZ/RigII, structural rows/RowsFinDim, canonical connection and integral-cusp finite generation remain available at their existing scopes. The active roadmap does not reopen them or restore Case II. Current root scope, checkpoint, continuation priorities, audit paths and reader titles all identify v0.48; the progress report's configuration/statistics hashes match the frozen inputs.
